exposure: Mifepristone combined with ethacridine lactate for induction
cohort: The study included 82 patients with stillbirth (dead before induction) in late pregnancy (>= 28 weeks) at a university-affiliated maternity center in Shanghai between October 2016 and September 2021.
finding: Mifepristone combined with ethacridine lactate was found to be a safe and low-risk induction method for patients with stillbirth in the third trimester, showing no increased risks in complications compared to non-ethacridine lactate induction.
